text_blocks.snippet: To get a Russian visa, you'll generally need a valid passport, a completed visa application form, a passport-sized photo, and an invitation or support letter from a Russian entity. Specific requirements vary depending on the visa type (tourist, business, etc.) and your nationality. Some nationalities may also need to provide proof of medical insurance, and additional documents may be requested at the embassy's discretion.
snippet_highlighted_words: a valid passport, a completed visa application form, a passport-sized photo, and an invitation or support letter from a Russian entity

list.title: Valid Passport:
list.snippet: Your passport must be valid for at least six months beyond your intended stay in Russia and have at least two blank pages.

list.title: Visa Application Form:
list.snippet: You'll need to complete the official Russian visa application form, either online or by hand.

list.title: Passport Photo:
list.snippet: Provide a recent passport-style photo (3.5cm x 4.5cm) that meets the Russian government's requirements (e.g., white background, 80% face visible).

list.title: Invitation or Support Letter:
list.snippet: Most visa types require an invitation or support letter from a Russian entity, such as a travel agency for tourist visas or the Ministry of Internal Affairs for other visa types, according to the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

list.title: Proof of Residence:
list.snippet: If not applying from your home country, you may need to provide proof of your legal residence in the country where you're applying.
Tourist Visa: Requires a "Tourist Confirmation" and "Tourist Voucher" from a registered Russian travel agency.
Business Visa: Requires an invitation from Russian immigration authorities.
Student Visa: Requires an invitation from Russian immigration authorities.
Private Visa: Requires a notarized invitation from a Russian citizen relative.
Visa Fees: Visa fees vary depending on your nationality and the type of visa.
Processing Times: Processing times can vary, so it's best to apply well in advance of your intended travel date.
Embassy/Consulate: You'll need to submit your application to the Russian Embassy or Consulate in your jurisdiction.
